arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Baumgartel argued the delegation provision grants unguided power to the top prosecutor.
She claimed this combines criminal law-making and executive power in a prohibited way.
Mr. Wall argued the text of the Act supports the government's interpretation.
He stated the law is best interpreted in the way the government has described.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests whether Congress can delegate rulemaking power to the Attorney General without setting specific standards. the sides that brought the case claim this delegation is unconstitutional. The government argues the statute provides sufficient guidance.
